findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed both water fountains to contain an accumulation of mineral buildup and limescale. A follow up will occur on 09/09/25 to check that the water fountain has been cleaned and sanitized. Ensure food contact surfaces are cleaned at a frequency to prevent the buildup of debris.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. [Pf]

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.comment: SECOND REPEAT- A gap that is approximately 1 cubic centimeter in area was observed at the bottom left corner along the threshold of the emergency exit door near the restrooms. A small gap could allow for the entrance of pests into the facility. Ensure the gap is sealed to eliminate a potential entry point for pests.
findings.citation_text: 6-202.15(A) Outer Openings, Protected. (A) Except as specified in (B), (C), and (E) and under (D) of this section, outer openings of a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by: (1) Filling or closing holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings; (2) Closed, tight-fitting windows; and (3) Solid, self-closing, tight-fitting doors. [C]

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
Inspector observed debris along multiple nonfood contact surfaces:
1) The last triple cooler labeled “cold drinks”
2) The “Fresh Foods” cooler
3) The first triple freezer labeled “Frozen foods”
4) The third triple freezer labeled “Frozen foods”
Ensure nonfood contact surfaces are cleaned at a frequency to prevent the accumulation of debris.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Gaps were observed in the coving (covering between the floor and wall) in the back storage area, as well as where two walls meet about 20’ away from the office. Seal gaps to provide a smooth, easily cleanable surface. Gaps between surfaces that expose bare wood or dry wall can harbor mold or other microorganisms. Ensure gaps are sealed or covered by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. [C]
